steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ and sign in with username 'admin' and password 'bench-admin-pass'. Then navigate to the repository 'bench/bench-repo' and go to its Issues tab. Report the titles of all OPEN issues whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed.

02-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo, create a new issue with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Issue created for run {{runid}}'). Submit it and report the new issue's number as displayed (e.g. '#4') and its title.

03-set: Navigate to the issue page for issue #4 ('{{runid}} Bench Issue') in the repository bench/bench-repo at http://127.0.0.1:8095/. Use the sidebar Labels picker to set exactly the two labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' (and no others). Confirm the app has applied them and the issue page now shows both label chips 'bug' and 'priority-high'. Report exactly which labels the issue page shows.

04-report: On the issue page for issue #4 ('{{runid}} Bench Issue') in bench/bench-repo, use the sidebar Assignees picker to assign the user 'bench-assignee'. Confirm the app has applied it and the issue page now shows 'bench-assignee' as the assignee in the sidebar. Report exactly what the sidebar shows for assignees.

05-set: On the issue page for issue #4 ('{{runid}} Bench Issue') in bench/bench-repo, use the sidebar Milestone picker to set the milestone to 'Bench Milestone'. Confirm the app has applied it and the issue page now shows 'Bench Milestone' in the sidebar. Report exactly what the sidebar shows for the milestone.

06-add: On the issue page for issue #4 ('{{runid}} Bench Issue') in bench/bench-repo, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit it and confirm the comment appears on the issue page with that text. Report the exact comment text shown on the page.

07-open: Open a fresh load of {{02-create.url}} and verify, reading the rendered page: (1) the issue title is exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and its number is displayed as '#4'; (2) the issue description/body text includes '{{runid}}'; (3) the sidebar shows exactly the labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' and no others; (4) the sidebar shows assignee 'bench-assignee'; (5) the sidebar shows milestone 'Bench Milestone'; (6) there is a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}'. Report each of these six facts with the exact text you observed, and state clearly if any check fails.
